artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan adding a shared source-store path classification library, an out-of-repository pre-check and repository-naming notice at the phase-commit site, a single-pathspec second-repository commit step, an authoring-boundary refusal of unexpanded-variable file_scope entries, and the documentation and gate/deploy closure.

memory_candidates.content: A file_scope entry naming a source-store path (agent-system/extensions/<name>/...) is NOT a uniform case across repositories: resolve .claude-extensions.json's per-extension source_dir, then that directory's enclosing git toplevel. When that toplevel equals the repository you are committing in, the path is an ordinary in-repo path and every containment check behaves normally; when it differs, the same literal string names a file this repository cannot hold at all. Any remedy for a source-store containment drop must therefore carry an explicit equality guard and be validated against a genuinely disjoint two-repository fixture, never against the repository that owns the source store, where the defect is invisible by construction.
